```{r setup}
library(abninferencestudy)
```

# Description

We are interested in the predictive performance of the ABN inference procedure across varying data characteristics and conditioning sets of evidence.
We analyse different graph structures with varying numbers of nodes, edge densities, maximal number of parents, node distribution types, and Markov blanket sizes. The goal is to evaluate how well the inference algorithm performs under these varying conditions, and how performance and runtime depend on the conditioning set of evidence.

# Effect of the distribution types

Fixed parameters:
- number of nodes $p = 12$,
- density $d = 0.4$,
- maximal number of parents $mp=5$.

Varying parameters:
- distribution type (`nodedists = balanced, G, P, B, M`).

```{r}
# Set the parameters to retrieve the data
n <- 100 # number of observations
p <- 12 # number of nodes
d <- 0.4 # density
mp <- 5 # maximal number of parents
n_graphs <- seq(1:10) # number of graphs 

nodedists_range <- c("balanced","G","P","B","M")  # distribution of nodes
evidence_type_list <- c("none", "children", "spouses", "parents", "mb") 

data_dir <- here("data")
results_dir <- here("results")
```

```{r}
# Progressbar
total_steps <- length(nodedists_range) * length(n_graphs)
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = total_steps, style = 3)
step_i <- 0

# Construct the filenames from the parameters
for (nodedists in nodedists_range){
  for (n_graph in n_graphs){
    step_i <- step_i + 1
    setTxtProgressBar(pb, step_i)
    
    # Construct the filename
    name_data <- paste0(
            "n_100_p_", p,
            "_nodedists_", nodedists,
            "_d_", gsub('[.]','',d),
            "_mp_", mp,
            "_graph", n_graph
          )
    
    in_file <- file.path(data_dir, paste0(name_data, ".Rdata"))
    out_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("abn_inference_", name_data, ".RData"))
    
    # Check if results already exist
    if (file.exists(out_file)) {
      message("Inference already exists for ", name_data, ". Skipping.")
      next
    }
              
    # Load the data
    if (!file.exists(in_file)) {
      message("Input file not found: ", name_data, ". Skipping.")
      next
    }
    
    # don't understand this, I would rather load the data
    load(in_file)
    obj_name <- ls(pattern = paste0("^", name_data))
    if (length(obj_name) == 0) {
      stop("No matching object found in the loaded file for: ", name_data)
    }
    data <- get(obj_name[1])
              
    # Inference with `abn` package
    possible_inference <- purrr::possibly(
      function(ev) RunABN_inference(dataset = data, evidence_type = ev, rngSEED = rngSEED),
      otherwise = NULL
    )
    abninferenceobj <- tryCatch(
        {
          res <- purrr::map(evidence_type_list, possible_inference)
          names(res) <- evidence_type_list
          res
        },
        error = function(e) {
          message("Error in inference for ", name_data, ": ", e$message)
          NULL
        }
    )

    elapsed_vec <- vapply(
      evidence_type_list,
      function(ev) {
        res <- abninferenceobj[[ev]]
        if (is.null(res) || is.null(res$timing)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(res$timing)
      },
      numeric(1)
    )
    names(elapsed_vec) <- evidence_type_list

    abninferenceobj_final <- list(
      none     = if (!is.null(abninferenceobj[["none"]])) abninferenceobj[["none"]]$predictions else NULL,
      parents  = if (!is.null(abninferenceobj[["children"]])) abninferenceobj[["parents"]]$predictions else NULL,
      children = if (!is.null(abninferenceobj[["spouses"]])) abninferenceobj[["children"]]$predictions else NULL,
      spouses  = if (!is.null(abninferenceobj[["parents"]])) abninferenceobj[["spouses"]]$predictions else NULL,
      mb       = if (!is.null(abninferenceobj[["mb"]])) abninferenceobj[["mb"]]$predictions else NULL,
      time     = elapsed_vec
    )
    
    # Check if abninferenceobj is NULL, if so, skip to the next iteration
    if (is.null(abninferenceobj_final)) {
      message("Inference returned NULL for ", name_data, ". Skipping.")
      next
    }   
  
    pred_obj_name <- paste0("abn_inference_", name_data)
    assign(pred_obj_name, abninferenceobj_final)
    save(list = pred_obj_name, file = out_file, compress = "xz")
    rm(list = pred_obj_name)
    gc()
  } # end of graph loop
} # end of dis loop
gc()
close(pb) # close the progress bar
cat("\nFinished at: ", as.character(Sys.time()), "\n")
```

# Effect of the Markov blanket size

Fixed parameters:
- number of nodes $p = 12$,
- density $d=0.4$,
- maximal number of parents $mp=5$.

Varying parameters:
- Markov blanket size $mb = 1,...,11$.
- distribution of target node (Gaussian, Poisson, binomial, or multinomial),
- distribution type (`nodedists = balanced, G, P, B, M`).

```{r}
# Set the parameters to retrieve the data
n <- 100 # number of observations
p <- 12 # number of nodes
d <- 0.4 # density
mp <- 5 # maximal number of parents
n_graphs <- seq(1:10) # number of graphs 

mb_range <- seq(from=1,to=11)
target_node_range <- c("g1","p1","b1","m1")
nodedists_range <- c("balanced","G","B","M")  # distribution of nodes
evidence_type_list <- c("none", "children", "spouses", "parents", "mb") 

data_dir <- here("data")
results_dir <- here("results")
```

```{r}
# Progressbar
total_steps <- length(nodedists_range) * length(n_graphs) * length(mb_range) * length(target_node_range)
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = total_steps, style = 3)
step_i <- 0

# Construct the filenames from the parameters
for (mb in mb_range){
  for (target_node in target_node_range){
    for (nodedists in nodedists_range){
      for (n_graph in n_graphs){
        step_i <- step_i + 1
        setTxtProgressBar(pb, step_i)
        
        # Construct the filename
        name_data <- paste0(
                "n_100_p_", p,
                "_nodedists_", nodedists,
                "_d_", gsub('[.]','',d),
                "_mp_", mp,
                "_MB_",mb,
                "_node_",target_node,
                "_graph", n_graph
              )
        
        in_file <- file.path(data_dir, paste0(name_data, ".Rdata"))
        out_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("abn_inference_", name_data, ".RData"))
        
        # Check if results already exist
        if (file.exists(out_file)) {
          message("Inference already exists for ", name_data, ". Skipping.")
          next
        }
                  
        # Load the data
        if (!file.exists(in_file)) {
          message("Input file not found: ", name_data, ". Skipping.")
          next
        }
        
        # don't understand this, I would rather load the data
        load(in_file)
        obj_name <- ls(pattern = paste0("^", name_data))
        if (length(obj_name) == 0) {
          stop("No matching object found in the loaded file for: ", name_data)
        }
        data <- get(obj_name[1])
                  
        # Inference with `abn` package
        possible_inference <- purrr::possibly(
          function(ev) RunABN_inference(dataset = data, evidence_type = ev, rngSEED = rngSEED),
          otherwise = NULL
        )
        abninferenceobj <- tryCatch(
            {
              res <- purrr::map(evidence_type_list, possible_inference)
              names(res) <- evidence_type_list
              res
            },
            error = function(e) {
              message("Error in inference for ", name_data, ": ", e$message)
              NULL
            }
        )
    
        elapsed_vec <- vapply(
          evidence_type_list,
          function(ev) {
            res <- abninferenceobj[[ev]]
            if (is.null(res) || is.null(res$timing)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(res$timing)
          },
          numeric(1)
        )
        names(elapsed_vec) <- evidence_type_list
    
        abninferenceobj_final <- list(
          none     = if (!is.null(abninferenceobj[["none"]])) abninferenceobj[["none"]]$predictions else NULL,
          parents  = if (!is.null(abninferenceobj[["children"]])) abninferenceobj[["parents"]]$predictions else NULL,
          children = if (!is.null(abninferenceobj[["spouses"]])) abninferenceobj[["children"]]$predictions else NULL,
          spouses  = if (!is.null(abninferenceobj[["parents"]])) abninferenceobj[["spouses"]]$predictions else NULL,
          mb       = if (!is.null(abninferenceobj[["mb"]])) abninferenceobj[["mb"]]$predictions else NULL,
          time     = elapsed_vec
        )
        
        # Check if abninferenceobj is NULL, if so, skip to the next iteration
        if (is.null(abninferenceobj_final)) {
          message("Inference returned NULL for ", name_data, ". Skipping.")
          next
        }   
      
        pred_obj_name <- paste0("abn_inference_", name_data)
        assign(pred_obj_name, abninferenceobj_final)
        save(list = pred_obj_name, file = out_file, compress = "xz")
        rm(list = pred_obj_name)
        gc()
      } # end of graph loop
    } # end of dist loop
  } # # end of target node loop
} # end of mb loop
gc()
close(pb) # close the progress bar
cat("\nFinished at: ", as.character(Sys.time()), "\n")
```
